You can do this by opening the "ReportsHSQLDB" data source in the data source editor in the GUI, and modifying the value of the "Database" field to match the name of the new database. 

You can also edit the ReportsHSQLDB data source in a text editor. 

1. Open the ReportsHSQLDB data source for editing. The name of the data source is <server_name>_ReportsHSQLDB.ds, and you can find it in the IMPACT_HOME/etc/ directory. 

 

2. Update the following property with the name of the imported HSQL database:

ReportsHSQLDB.HSQLDB.PRIMARYDATABASE=<new_database_name>

3. Save the changes to the ReportsHSQLDB data source, and close the text editor.

Both these methods, require a restart of the Impact Server.

IBM Tivoli Netcool/Impact: Changing the wasadmin default password - United States

Impact 5.1; wasadmin; account TECHNOTE (FAQ)

THIS DOCUMENT APPLIES ONLY TO THE FOLLOWING LANGUAGE VERSION(S):
 English 

QUESTION
 How do I change the wasadmin account password? 

ANSWER
Follow the procedure outlined in the attached document "How to Change Wasadmin password". 

How to Change Wasadmin password.doc [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21426040&aid=2] [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21426040&aid=1]

RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
Manually migrate MWM :
1) Login to Impact 6.1.1 go to MWM project , then go to Data Model panel. 

2) Check the configuration in ImpactDB data source. Update accordingly. Derby database connection : default username is impact and default password is derbypass. 

3) Go to the Service section and you can start and stop the database using the server ImpactDatabase.

SYMPTOM
[impact71@impact71 bin]$ ./startGUIServer.sh 

Starting server ImpactUI.
Server ImpactUI started with process ID 3006.
[FATAL ] Unable to start the Netcool/Impact server due to authentication problems
Unable to successfully start GUI Server ImpactUI


CAUSE
One cause of this error is a change of the password of the user configured to bind to LDAP
